::: {.lead-tagline}
Statistician. These days I like to discuss data science, statistical learning and their applications — preferably over coffee.
:::

## What I am working on

::: {.card-grid}
::: {}
Research

Statistical methods for data mining and machine learning, team [MSDMA](https://cedric.cnam.fr/) of the [CEDRIC](https://cedric.cnam.fr/) lab.
:::
::: {}
Teaching

[EPN 6 — Mathematics & Statistics](https://maths.cnam.fr/), the national teaching team at Cnam.
:::
::: {}
Master in Statistics

Tracks *Data Science* and *Risk statistics for finance and insurance* at [Cnam](https://formation.cnam.fr/).
:::

## Research interests

Spatial statistics · Networks and block models · Influence measures and stability · Classification trees and ensemble methods · Probabilistic real-time systems · Statistics for life sciences, ecology and public health.

See the [publications](publications.qmd) page, or my [Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.fr/citations?user=JZ3uW60AAAAJ) for an up-to-date list.
